roms.title: Apple][Go replacement ROM
roms.author: Marc Ressl
roms.evidence: Documented on AppleIIGo ROMs page as a public-domain Apple ][ replacement ROM written in 2006 by Marc Ressl for the Apple][Go emulator. Capable of running most games not requiring Applesoft.
roms.notes: Not an Apple proprietary ROM. Games requiring Applesoft may need a user-supplied II+ ROM instead.
